instructions.primary_message: Disclaimer: A heart healthy diet should include whole grains, fresh fruits and vegetables, low fat dairy, lean protein and legumes, and should limit fat, saturated fat, cholesterol and sodium.
Place Quaker® oats and salt, if desired, in microwave-safe bowl (at least 4-cup capacity).
Add egg (or egg white) to oats. Stir to combine (no specks of yolk should show if using whole egg). Stir in zucchini. Add milk; stir until all ingredients are well combined.
For old fashioned oats, microwave on HIGH, uncovered, 2 minutes. Stir oats, microwave about 1 minute longer in 30 second intervals, stirring after each interval until egg and oats are cooked.
For quick oats, microwave on HIGH, uncovered, 2 to 2-1/2 minutes or until egg is fully cooked and oats are desired consistency.
Let stand 1 to 2 minutes before stirring in other ingredients if thicker consistency is desired.
Chef's Tip: Top with Greek-style yogurt, fresh fruit, berries or nuts, as desired.
